about.bio: I'm a full-stack engineer with 6 years of experience turning ideas into polished, production-ready products. I specialize in React, Next.js, and TypeScript on the frontend, and pair them with Node.js, NestJS, and PostgreSQL/Supabase on the backend, so I can own a feature from the UI all the way to the API and database. I'm currently building a cross-platform monorepo with NestJS, Next.js, and React Native, where web and mobile clients share one clean, secure backend.
focus: Owning features end-to-end, from interface and API design to database modeling and deployment
Building accessible, performant interfaces and treating them as engineering requirements, not afterthoughts
Collaborating with designers and backend teams on reusable component libraries and clean API boundaries, including role-based auth that works across web and mobile
about.storyhook: I've applied these skills to products like HuntLedger, a job application tracker with automated follow-up reminders, and contributed to Clusta.co, an estate management platform built with a 4-person team. I'm now building a NestJS, Next.js, and React Native monorepo. You can explore these projects in detail below

experience.title: Estate Management SaaS
experience.description: Key frontend developer on a 4-person team building a modern estate management SaaS application. Translated complex UI/UX designs into functional, high-performance code. Collaborated closely with backend developers and designers to ensure seamless integration and a cohesive user experience.
achievements: Single-handedly engineered the marketing landing page using React, significantly improving initial user engagement and conversion.
Collaborated on the development of the main application dashboard using Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, ensuring type safety, server-side rendering, and a responsive layout.
Implemented and maintained a reusable component library, improving development consistency and speed across the team.

experience.title: Job Application Tracker
experience.description: Designed and developed a full-stack job application tracker from concept to production. The application helps job seekers organize their search, with automated reminders to ensure timely follow-ups. I owned the entire development lifecycle, from UI/UX design to deployment and backend logic.
achievements: Engineered a responsive Next.js application with App Router for efficient routing and server-side rendering, improving SEO and initial load performance.
Implemented a full CRUD interface with Firebase Firestore for real-time data synchronization and Firebase Auth for secure user management.
Architected and built a custom scheduled task system (e.g., for email reminders) using a serverless approach, demonstrating strong backend problem-solving skills.
Styled the application with Tailwind CSS to create a clean, accessible, and modern user interface.

experience.title: Developer Blog Platform
experience.description: Designed and built a full-stack developer blog platform with user authentication, image uploads, and a custom content management system. This project demonstrates a strong grasp of both frontend and backend development within the MERN ecosystem, along with integration of modern tooling for image handling and user management.
achievements: Developed a blog platform using the MERN stack, with server-side rendered pages via Next.js for improved SEO and performance.
Integrated NextAuth for secure user authentication, allowing role-based access to protected routes like the admin dashboard.
Built custom API routes in Next.js for post creation, editing, and deletion, connecting seamlessly with a MongoDB backend.
Implemented image uploads using UploadThing with validation and storage handling, enabling users to upload blog thumbnails and content images.
Designed a clean and responsive UI using Tailwind CSS, optimized for readability and user engagement across devices.

tobeupdated.title: Meal Orchestration Platform
tobeupdated.description: Designing and building a cross-platform meal ordering and scheduling system as a monorepo, where a single NestJS API serves both a Next.js web client and a React Native mobile client. I own the full system: architecture, API design, database schema, and both frontends.
achievements: Architected a monorepo with a shared NestJS API, a Next.js web app, and a React Native mobile app, keeping API boundaries clean so features can be added to either client independently.
Implemented role-based authentication and authorization that works consistently across web and mobile clients against the same backend.
Modeled and managed data in Supabase (PostgreSQL), covering multi-role ordering and scheduling workflows.
Built the web client with Next.js, TanStack Query, and shadcn/ui for reliable data fetching and a consistent component system.

tobeupdated.title: Paid DM Platform
tobeupdated.description: Building a subscription-gated direct messaging platform where access to conversations is controlled by paid plans. I'm handling the full stack, from the interface to access control logic and real-time messaging.
achievements: Implemented paid access control so messaging features are gated by subscription status.
Built real-time messaging on Supabase, with Next.js powering the interface and server-side logic.
Designed the data model and permissions for users, conversations, and subscription state.

tobeupdated.title: CustomHub: Product Customization Platform
tobeupdated.description: Designed and built an e-commerce platform for personalized apparel, drinkware, and office accessories. Customers design their own products in a responsive live-preview tool and check out through an integrated Stripe payment flow.
achievements: Built a responsive product customization tool that lets users personalize apparel, drinkware, and office products with a live preview.
Integrated Stripe to handle secure checkout and payments end-to-end.
Styled the interface with Tailwind CSS for a clean experience across mobile and desktop.

tobeupdated.title: Banking Dashboard
tobeupdated.description: Developed a responsive financial data visualization dashboard with Next.js and TypeScript, with automated deployments through a CI/CD pipeline.
achievements: Built a dynamic, responsive dashboard presenting financial data in a clear, scannable layout.
Set up automated CI/CD deployment pipelines with GitHub Actions, so every merge ships without manual steps.
Used TypeScript throughout for type safety across components and data handling.
